scope: The 2 admitted X509_VERIFY_POLICY production obligation(s) in src/x509/v3_admis.rs that the enumerated SSH closure reports as reachable but without an owning boundary receipt are enumerated here for ownership only, at their census coordinates, with a hazard read from each function. This receipt claims no discharge, no contract and no new reachability finding.
non_claims: This receipt does not discharge any site, and no site may be treated as discharged on its authority.
This receipt does not contract any site; the hazard notes are enumeration notes, not established contracts.
This receipt does not assert reachability; reachability is taken from the enumerated closure and is not re-established here.

boundaries.hazard: Raw NAMING_AUTHORITY is dereferenced after a null check; its three fields are printed through OBJ/BIO calls, returning 0 for an all-absent authority or a failed write.
Raw ADMISSION_SYNTAX and its contentsOfAdmissions stack are dereferenced; each entry pointer is passed to GENERAL_NAME_print and the raw naming-authority printer.
